nodes.name: Error Trigger (All Workflows)
nodes.notes: Fires for ANY workflow error in the n8n instance. Captures execution id, workflow id, node name, error message, stack trace, and timestamp.

nodes.name: Log to Audit (DB)
nodes.notes: Persists the error to the Dayjoy audit_logs table via the backend audit-logs API. Non-blocking on failure — downstream alert still fires.

nodes.name: Retry Transient (3x / 30s)
nodes.notes: Transient errors (timeouts, 5xx, connection resets, 429) get auto-retried up to 3 times with a 30-second linear backoff via the backend retry orchestrator.

nodes.name: Check External Service Health
nodes.notes: Probes the external provider (WhatsApp / SendGrid / Razorpay / Google) for an outage before deciding to retry vs. alert.

nodes.name: Page On-Call (Critical Auth)
nodes.notes: CRITICAL severity only — auth errors page the on-call engineer via PagerDuty. Dedup key prevents alert storms.

meta.description: Catches every workflow error in the n8n instance, classifies it (transient/data/auth/external), logs to audit DB, and routes to the right team. Transient errors auto-retry 3x/30s; auth errors page on-call; data errors go to data team; external errors probe the provider then alert ops.
